description: This file defines functions and types related to configuring channel access policies, including parsing, formatting, and prompting for allowlist entries and access policies, utilizing a WizardPrompter interface.

methods.name: parseAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Parses raw string input into an array of allowlist entries by splitting setup entries.

methods.name: formatAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Formats an array of allowlist entries into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: promptChannelAccessPolicy
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a channel access policy from options.

methods.name: promptChannelAllowlist
methods.description: Prompts the user to input allowlist entries as a comma-separated string and parses it.

methods.name: promptChannelAccessConfig
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure channel access, including policy and allowlist entries, with options to skip or update.
